$comment: Beginner layer: the 'At a glance' strip on compound pages, the summary box's reading time and the technical-details block. Answers are keyed by data values (vocab.ts), so every compound with the same facts gets the same words. Keep every answer to one plain line (B1, everyday words, no jargon).

glance.title: At a glance
glance.checked: Status checked on {date}. The details and sources are further down this page.

authorised.text: Approved in the EU. Only with a doctor’s prescription.

authorised-elsewhere.text: Approved only in some countries outside the EU.

investigational.text: Not approved. It is still being tested in trials.

experimental.text: Not approved as a medicine anywhere.

not-a-peptide-authorised.text: It is not a peptide, but it is an approved medicine in the EU.

not-a-peptide-authorised-elsewhere.text: It is not a peptide. It is approved only in some countries outside the EU.

not-a-peptide-not-authorised.text: It is not a peptide, and it is not an approved medicine in the EU.

tested.question: Has it been tested in people?

none.text: No studies in people have been published.

case-reports.text: Only reports about a few patients, not proper trials.

phase-1.text: Only small safety studies in people.

phase-2.text: Small trials in patients. No large trials published yet.

phase-3.text: Large trials in many people have been published.

authorised.text: Large trials in many people, checked by regulators.

prohibited.at-all-times: Banned in sport at all times.

not-listed.text: It is not on the anti-doping list.

unknown.text: Check the sport row in the status table.

risk.question: What is the biggest risk?
risk.fallback: Warning signs: when to stop and get help

readingTime.one: Reading the whole page takes about {minutes} minute.
readingTime.other: Reading the whole page takes about {minutes} minutes.
